method: split conformal selection (Lei, G'Sell, Rinaldo, Tibshirani & Wasserman, JASA 2018)
unit_of_exchangeability: spatial holdout block (8x8 contiguous cells, whole catalogue components, prevalence-matched instruments)
note_ranking_key: preregistered: max PM0200 selection-half mean DTI, then worst normalised mean over the five instruments, then larger minimum spacing

guarantee.caveat: The code chooses on the selection half and computes the fixed-arm floor on disjoint calibration blocks. The finite-sample interpretation still requires a candidate grid and selection rule fixed independently of calibration and exchangeable future/spatial blocks; this script cannot verify those design assumptions or prospective protocol timing. Repeated splits reuse the same blocks and are sensitivity diagnostics, not independent validation samples.
guarantee.dkw_method: Massart DKW CDF bound with fixed metric support; not scaled by observed sample range
guarantee.dkw_scope: fixed selected-arm calibration-block mean under iid sampling, conditional on selection-only choice

interpretation.record_type: historical first-run public catalogue proxy calculation, superseded by the H49 Instrument-B addendum
interpretation.target: held-out public catalogue components, not private organizer labels
interpretation.comparator: any legacy REF_incumbent_0.2778 key denotes an owner-reported d2.8 reference; score/file link unverified
interpretation.legacy_gate_scope: The adjacent legacy gates object is a historical first-run public-catalogue proxy comparison only. Its all_gates_pass=true field is not the current scientific promotion gate, submission eligibility, or slot authorization; the current interpretation fields below are false.
interpretation.legacy_gate_comparator_semantics: Any legacy REF_incumbent_0.2778 key refers only to an owner-reported d2.8 reference raster; the participant-score/file association is unverified and it is not an authenticated leaderboard incumbent.
